title: How to Use the Russian Tie by Jeff Glover
whyUseful: Jeff Glover shows the grip, the elbow position and the ways he attacks off the tie, which is the clearest entry point for the control itself.

title: Wrestling for BJJ with the Russian Arm Tie Control
whyUseful: Treats the Russian arm tie as a no-gi wrestling tool for jiu-jitsu rather than for folkstyle, and covers the entry and the follow-ups.

title: Throw Away Takedown from 2on1 (Russian Tie) for BJJ. - Tutorial
whyUseful: Shows a specific throw built from the two-on-one, useful once the control is already secure and you want a finish from it.
